core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghaniya is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Rich, free from want (feminine)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghaniya corresponds to the Arabic form غنية (Arabic root غ ن ي (gh-n-y)). Its core sense is wealthy, rich, self-sufficient. Ghaniya is Arabic غنية (Ghaniyya) 'rich, free from want (feminine)'. The source gloss 'the grateful one' confuses غنيّ 'rich' with شاكرة 'grateful' and has been replaced. It is effectively the same name as ghania, recorded under a separate slug.

persian.name: غنيه
persian.long_meaning: Ghaniya (غنيه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن توانگر، بی‌نیاز است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: ग़निया

arabic.name: غنية
